output.summary: System records show first-contact demand up only 4%, while agent-created split tickets (240 to 3,710), customer duplicates and reopens exploded after the per-agent quota began. Closes per agent rose, so effort is not the issue. Headcount and hours are flat. The reopen trigger and report are unchanged, so the reopen rise is not an artifact. The quota-exempt Billing pod stayed stable, which acts as a natural control. Payroll adds about 380 first-contact tickets a month, too few to explain the backlog. Resignations are confounded by the pay deferral and a competitor offering 15% more. The Engineering bug contribution is unresolved. Suspend the per-agent quota and classify the aged tickets. Adding agents or raising the quota would worsen things.
